evaluationPolicy: Identical updated byte-aware scorers use complete isolated runtimes for baseline and current. Updated algorithms frozen before fresh outputs inspected; no tuning on these reports. All earlier fixtures are development/debug evidence.
limits: Synthetic images, not real camera photographs or Scanbot comparisons.
POS profiles are fixed-image worker calls; live profile is only retry index 0. Neither exercises camera acquisition, selection, adaptive capture or confirmation.

Semantic safety suite has 10 QR payload groups (40 variants), four other-format groups (eight variants), six two-label scenes and eight negatives. No explicit ECI/GS1 QR/structured append. Raw bytes are authoritative; printable ASCII also requires exact text.
Sequential single-run host latency excludes startup, camera, HTTP and UI; not phone speed.
Any unexpected value fails a command; correct plus wrong extra is unsuccessful.
